headline: Ten shelves in the sky — MARBLE RUSH is complete
lede: Shelves 6–10 land with two new verbs — sweeping neon bars you time with the stick alone, and checkpoint gates that bring you back mid-shelf with the clock still honest. Then the nightly went red on six checks and every root cause got fixed and proof-flown before handoff.

notes.text: #3107 shipped and closed: THE SPIRE is the final exam; the autopilot golds all ten with medals a hair off the bot.
Checkpoint gates: fall past a green arch and Space drops you back at the gate — clock running, score intact, medals honest. Bars knock ±5.2 m/s with a 0.5 s immunity, never needing a second button.

Red main cleared (#3193): six nightly failures traced to four roots — soak roster drift (#1525 law), GrindCity's viewport, cometcheck dirtying tracked PNGs into a mutant freeze, and mergecheck meeting Linux for the first time. CI proof went green on the branch before merge.
